Explanation: The field is mandatory present if gnss-id is set to sbas. It is absent otherwise.

The field is optionally present, Need R, if posSI-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message included in posSchedulingInfoList or if si-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message containing type2 SIB included in schedulingInfoList2. It is absent otherwise.

The field is optionally present, Need R, if supplementaryUplink is configured in ServingCellConfigCommonSIB, and if posSI-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message included in posSchedulingInfoList or if si-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message containing type2 SIB included in schedulingInfoList2. It is absent otherwise.

The field is optionally present, Need R, if initialUplinkBWP-RedCap is configured in UplinkConfigCommonSIB, and if posSI-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message included in posSchedulingInfoList or if si-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message containing type2 SIB included in schedulingInfoList2. It is absent otherwise.
